page.layout: One page of title text, centred; no columns, no margin notes. Below the text a short line at the foot of the page.
page.notes: Title page with decorative type; no running head, page number, catchword or signature printed. Some ink specks and scan stains on the page were disregarded. The line "Lausanne ad Kalend." reads "Lausanne" in the scan as "Lausanne" with a long s form; spelled as printed. Final word "BENE." is followed by a printer's point. The foot of the scan shows a rule and a faint stamp, not transcribed. Uncertain readings: "Obsequentissimus" and "Humillimus" were read from italic type and may contain printer's variants.
